definition: used to say what is the right or best thing to do
examples: You should drink more water every day.

definition: to be able to do something, or to be allowed to
examples: I can swim, but not very fast.

definition: to put things into groups or into order
examples: Please sort the books by size.

definition: to say or write something clearly and formally
examples: The report will state the main results.

definition: to tell someone about a fact officially
examples: Please inform the teacher if you will be absent.

definition: to plan or mean to do something
examples: I intend to finish the course by June.

meaning: bao gồm; liên quan, kéo vào
definition: to include something as a necessary part, or to make someone take part
examples: The job will involve some travel abroad.

definition: to cause a person, animal or plant to die
examples: Too much water can kill a cactus.

meaning: đại diện cho; tượng trưng cho
definition: to speak or act for someone, or to stand for something
examples: Two students will represent our class at the meeting.

definition: to move by turning over and over, or to make into a tube shape
examples: Help me roll the carpet before we move it.

definition: to put something in a place, to fix a time or rule, or to go down below the horizon
examples: Let's set a date for the next meeting.

definition: to say that something is true, or to ask for something that is yours
examples: He likes to claim that he never gets lost.

definition: to do something wrong or illegal, or to promise to give time or effort
examples: Few people commit crimes in this quiet town.

definition: to show where something is with your finger
examples: Please point to the word you do not know.

definition: to push something firmly
examples: Press the green button to start the machine.

definition: to think of someone or something in a particular way
examples: Many people regard her as the best teacher in the school.

definition: to let someone or something go free, or to make a film or product available
examples: The band will release a new song next week.

definition: to use something as the main reason or starting point for something else
examples: We base our prices on the cost of materials.

definition: to destroy or damage something with fire or heat
examples: Don't burn the toast this time.

definition: to move something quickly up and down or from side to side
examples: Shake the bottle before you open it.

definition: to say that you are not happy about something
examples: Customers often complain about slow delivery.

meaning: liên quan đến; làm lo lắng
definition: to be about or affect someone, or to make someone worried
examples: This change does not concern first-year students.

definition: to be made of particular parts (consist of)
examples: The test will consist of three short sections.

definition: to call, write to or email someone
examples: Please contact us if you have any questions.

definition: to feel that something is important, or to look after someone
examples: Good doctors care about their patients.

definition: to ask for money for something, or to put electricity into a battery
examples: Some hotels charge extra for breakfast.

definition: to be real or present
examples: Do you think life could exist on other planets?

definition: to show a feeling or opinion in words or actions
examples: Children often express their feelings through drawing.

definition: to make something longer or bigger
examples: The library will extend its opening hours during exams.

definition: to not succeed in doing something
examples: If you don't study, you may fail the test.

definition: to close or join something so that it stays firmly in place
examples: Please fasten your seatbelt before we leave.

definition: to give food to a person or an animal
examples: It is my job to feed the cat every morning.

meaning: đánh nhau; chiến đấu, đấu tranh
definition: to use force against someone, or to try hard to stop something bad
examples: Doctors fight hard to save every patient.

definition: to make something full
examples: Please fill the jug with cold water.

definition: to be the right size or shape for someone or something
examples: These shoes don't fit me any more.

definition: to bend something so that one part lies on another
examples: Fold the paper in half.

definition: to ask formally for something, or to use a rule or method
examples: You can apply the same rule to other verbs.

definition: to disagree angrily, or to give reasons for an opinion
examples: My brothers often argue about football.

definition: to try to hurt or damage someone or something
examples: Some dogs attack when they feel afraid.

definition: to go or put something where others cannot see or find it
examples: The children like to hide behind the curtains.

definition: to touch someone or something hard with your hand or an object
examples: Try to hit the ball over the net.

definition: to say that something is not true, or to refuse to give something
examples: He continued to deny that he broke the window.

definition: to damage something so badly that it cannot be used
examples: The storm could destroy the old bridge.

definition: to stop living
examples: Plants die without enough light.

definition: to talk about something with other people
examples: Let's discuss the plan after lunch.
